text_block_list.text:
With her target race, the Challenge Cup, 
approaching, Marvelous Sunday suffered an 
injury, this time to her left leg.

Though she had always taken any hardship 
in stride, her smile has faded, leaving 
her looking terribly frail and 
downhearted.

However—the students she has cheered on, 
the young boy she met in the hospital 
room, the townspeople; everyone is praying 
for her recovery.

The "Marvelous" that she has steadily 
nurtured. Now, it pushes her forward from 
behind. Once again, a radiant smile 
returns to her face.
